stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: I forgot to redraw the total again.

stations.title: One state
stations.text: Holds the order, but tells nobody.

stations.title: Your store
stations.gap: Nobody is told of a change

captions: Sefton adds 40 posters to an order, and the total on the screen does not move.
The store holds the new order, but nothing tells the total it changed.
You let parts listen and tell them after every change, in three tasks.
Now the total hears about the posters the moment they are added.
Every part is told once per change, and nobody when nothing changed.
